segments.text:
V. 11.
Our Friend Lazarus ſleepeth—This He ſpoke, juſt when he died. Sleepeth—Such is the Death of Good Men in the Language of Heaven. But the Diſciples did not yet underſtand this Language. And the Slowneſs of our Underſtanding makes the Scripture often deſcend to our barbarous Manner of ſpeaking.
